centre.description: The largest planet, flattened by its fast spin, with four faint rings of dust drawn at their real distances.
knownLimitations: Jupiter is drawn flat in one colour, without cloud bands: Planetary Explorer's Jupiter map has no recorded source or licence, so no texture is used.
The surface drawn is the 1-bar cloud-top level, not a solid surface.
The rings are drawn as flat bands in Planetary Explorer's colours; their brightness is a look, not a measurement.

mapped.description: The innermost large moon of Jupiter, always turning the same face towards it.
The second large moon, an ice shell over a hidden ocean.
The largest moon in the solar system, bigger than Mercury.
The outermost large moon, the most heavily cratered surface known.
